caption:
Finishing off our beloved pretzels :) 

This recipe makes 6 and is the perfect small batch recipe 

Refer my previous reel on how to make the dough

For cooking the pretzels, 
You need 4 cups of water + 50 grams of baking soda 
Boil both ingredients together and place the pretzels one at a time into the liquid and allow both sides to poach for 30 seconds each :) 

After all your pretzels are done poaching, sprinkle with sea salt and bake in a preheated oven at 205 degrees for 20-25 minutes till beautiful and golden brown!!
